job.job_description:
We Are Hiring | Exavalu Solutions India | Senior AI Engineer- GenAI | AWS | MLOps | Work From Home

Note: Please do not apply if your notice is more than 30 days.

Location: Hybrid (Kolkata & Chennai) | For other location Work from Home 

Are you passionate about building production-ready AI systems and transforming the potential of Generative AI into real-world enterprise solutions?

This could be your next big opportunity!

At Exavalu, we are building innovative technology solutions at the intersection of Insurance, Data, AI and Cloud. We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on AI Engineering Lead who can help us design, build, deploy and scale the next generation of intelligent enterprise solutions.

About Exavalu

Exavalu is a global consulting and technology services company specializing in Digital Transformation, Cloud Engineering, Data & AI Solutions, and enterprise platform implementations.

We serve global clients across Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, and BFSI sectors, delivering scalable and high-impact technology solutions.




Website: https://www.exavalu.com

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/exavalu/




You will get the opportunity to work on:

Cutting-edge AI & Generative AI solutions
Modern Cloud technologies and AWS ecosystem
LLMs, RAG and enterprise AI platforms
Large-scale Data & AI engineering challenges
Enterprise and regulated industry use cases

Building AI solutions that move beyond experimentation into real production environments

If you enjoy solving complex problems and want to be part of building intelligent, scalable and responsible AI solutions, we'd love to hear from you!




Position: AI Engineering Lead / Architect

Experience: 7+ Years Overall

AI/ML Engineering Experience: Minimum 3+ Years

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred




What We're Looking For

Hands-on experience building production-grade AI/ML systems
Strong expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG & NLP
Experience with AWS Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker
Strong knowledge of AWS Lambda, S3, Glue & EKS
Experience building Data & AI pipelines
Strong understanding of MLOps, CI/CD, Monitoring & Model Versioning
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.
Exposure to Docker & Kubernetes
Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI Security, Guardrails & Governance

Domain Preference

Experience in the Insurance domain will be an added advantage.




Interview Steps: Technical Round (online) --> Leadership Round --> Face to face final Round (Mandatory in office) --> HR Round
